label: Your average is your total pinfall divided by games bowled, recalculat
value: Your average is your total pinfall divided by games bowled, recalculated after every league night. Handicap is a percentage of the difference between your average and the league base — for Monday Mixed that's 80% of 200. Bowl 15 games and your average is locked in as established for tournament entry.
